name: resizable-45
description: Sidebar that collapses to an icon rail using a collapsed size.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Calendar as CalendarIcon, House as HomeIcon, Inbox as InboxIcon, Users as UsersIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { ResizableHandle, ResizablePanel, ResizablePanelGroup, } from "@workspace/ui/components/resizable" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const items = [ { label: "Home", icon: HomeIcon }, { label: "Inbox", icon: InboxIcon }, { label: "Calendar", icon: CalendarIcon }, { label: "Team", icon: UsersIcon }, ] export default function IconRailCollapsedSize() { const [compact, setCompact] = React.useState(false) return ( setCompact(size.inPixels <= 56)} >
{items.map((item) => ( {!compact && {item.label}} ))}
Drag the sidebar narrower to snap it into an icon rail.
) }
